supplemental_items.interpretation: Frozen slotted BlueState and AZone declarations; optional keyword-only presentation provenance defaults null; no calculation in annotation. Nested BlueState.line remains referenced, not copied.

supplemental_items.discovery_reason: Source-first state mutation, provenance, ordered evaluation, fallback or boundary beyond original category labels.
supplemental_items.interpretation: Validate direction before state. Store policy, shallow-copy Reaction list and stable sort all Blue by integer ordinal, source time, string kind. Native sort key evaluated in field order; equal keys preserve input order. No removal of invalid/internal records.

supplemental_items.discovery_reason: Source-first state mutation, provenance, ordered evaluation, fallback or boundary beyond original category labels.
supplemental_items.interpretation: Chronology arrays/index are direct references. Build entire First list, then Break list, then virtual confirmation list; independent ordered_naive_datetimes checks occur after all three. Base A14 calls RE61 with intrabar disabled; live override reviewed later. No sorting of Reaction times.

supplemental_items.discovery_reason: Source-first state mutation, provenance, ordered evaluation, fallback or boundary beyond original category labels.
supplemental_items.interpretation: Property and four wrappers delegate stored policy or chronology; no extra validation/clamp or alternate fallback.

supplemental_items.discovery_reason: Source-first state mutation, provenance, ordered evaluation, fallback or boundary beyond original category labels.
supplemental_items.interpretation: Lower bounds start inclusive, end exclusive or current length. Nonempty indexed path returns null for no hit; source row fetched by returned position and normalized before main mapping. Timestamp map result is position rather than native candle.index.

supplemental_items.discovery_reason: Source-first state mutation, provenance, ordered evaluation, fallback or boundary beyond original category labels.
supplemental_items.interpretation: If no indexed path, iterate lower slice; nonempty no-hit suppresses main fallback. Empty slice permits main lower-bound opens from start through exclusive end, clamp end upward to start. No containing-main predecessor in A07, return native integer candle.index.

supplemental_items.discovery_reason: Source-first state mutation, provenance, ordered evaluation, fallback or boundary beyond original category labels.
supplemental_items.interpretation: Reject reversed range before adding one microsecond. Inclusive exact time window, native overflow propagates. Indexed extreme returns price directly and maps lower_times[position], not row timestamp attribute; main timestamp separately read.

supplemental_items.discovery_reason: Source-first state mutation, provenance, ordered evaluation, fallback or boundary beyond original category labels.
supplemental_items.interpretation: Nonindexed lower path calls chronology.lower_window, seeds first, strict replacement preserves first equal row. Map selected lower timestamp to main position; do not return lower source timestamp as A source main time.

supplemental_items.discovery_reason: Source-first state mutation, provenance, ordered evaluation, fallback or boundary beyond original category labels.
supplemental_items.interpretation: Empty lower fallback uses upper-bound predecessors at both endpoints, includes containing candles, clamps start only upward and end to len-1. Seed even if selected end<start; no local empty/out-of-range repair. Main fallback returns native integer candle.index, not positional index.
